game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order. Each round, vine horrors strike the crypt seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from vine horrors in Whisper Stones: keep the clean_list meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: clean_list drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Whisper Stones'.
